input: Plan a gap year itinerary before graduate school

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Gap Year Itinerary Before Grad School
gold.taskDescription: Create a detailed, personalized gap year itinerary to fill the time between completing undergraduate studies and starting graduate school.

questions.title: When exactly does your gap year start and end?
questions.description: Identify the precise start date (e.g., graduation month) and the hard deadline when graduate school begins, to define the total available window.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the entire year?
questions.description: Establish the overall financial envelope available for the gap year, including travel, living expenses, and any planned activities.

questions.title: Which countries or regions are you drawn to visiting?
questions.description: Determine geographic preferences or must-see destinations to anchor the itinerary around specific locations.

questions.title: What is the primary purpose of this gap year?
questions.description: Clarify whether the main goal is travel and exploration, skill-building, volunteering, work experience, rest and recovery, or a mix of these.

questions.title: Will you be traveling solo or with others?
questions.description: Understand whether the itinerary needs to accommodate a partner, friends, or group travel logistics versus solo planning.

questions.title: Do you need to earn income during the gap year?
questions.description: Determine if working remotely, doing seasonal jobs, or teaching English abroad needs to be built into the schedule.

questions.title: What field is your graduate program, and does it influence your plans?
questions.description: Find out if the graduate school subject creates any relevant goals for the gap year, such as field research, language learning, or industry exposure.
